name: Deterministic calculation engine with incremental recalc
description: Formulas with references, ranges, operators, and 17 functions; typed error values that propagate; cycle detection with recovery; only dirty dependents re-evaluate on edit.
acceptance: Eval-count proves incremental recalculation
Cycles flag every participant #CYCLE! and recover when broken
Errors propagate through operators and aggregates
knownLimitations: No differential testing against Excel yet (§7.2); no dynamic arrays, volatile functions, or external data

name: Grid application slice
description: 12×40 grid rendering engine values, formula-bar editing, Enter/Tab/arrow navigation, numeric/error styling, autosave, CSV export of displayed values.
acceptance: Boot renders seeded model with computed values
Formula-bar commit updates all dependents in one edit
Autosave persists inputs (not values) and restores them
knownLimitations: Fixed grid size; no cell ranges selection, formatting, undo, or charts yet

name: XLSX export/import with differential value checks
description: Export workbooks (inline strings, formulas with cached values, booleans, error cells); import inline- and sharedStrings-style producers, re-evaluating formulas and reporting mismatches vs the producer stored values; styles import to our format subset.
edgeCases: unsupported functions surface as #NAME? and are reported
acceptance: Export-import round-trip preserves inputs and recomputed displays
Mismatches vs producer-stored values are reported, never hidden
openpyxl reads formulas and cached values from exports

evidence.ref: openpyxl cross-validation of export; openpyxl-produced fixture imports with 0 warnings

knownLimitations: Single sheet; no formatting/styles; no real-Excel corpus yet

name: Cell formatting (bold, alignment, number formats)
description: Per-cell display formats — bold, left/center/right alignment, Number/Currency/Percent — applied from the toolbar, persisted with the sheet, rendered in the grid and CSV display values, and exported as real XLSX styles (numFmts + fonts + cellXfs). Values and the dependency graph are untouched by formatting. XLSX import reads styles back (bold, alignment, number formats via builtin ids and format-code heuristics), so styled round-trips are lossless; unrepresentable aspects warn once with specifics.
edgeCases: clearing to general removes stored format
acceptance: Display formats never change computed values
entries() round-trips formats including format-only cells
openpyxl reads exported bold and number formats back

evidence.ref: calc format suites + xlsx style suite: pass (120 unit total)
openpyxl cross-validation: bold + numFmts read back
style import suites + openpyxl-styled foreign fixture (bold/currency/percent/center imported)

knownLimitations: No fills, borders, italic, fonts, or column widths yet (dropped with a specific warning on import)

name: Range selection, clipboard, and column widths
description: Drag/Shift range selection with live label; Ctrl/Cmd-C/X/V with Excel-style relative-formula rebasing ($ anchors pinned, #REF! on out-of-range), formats traveling, TSV interop with the system clipboard where permitted; Delete clears ranges; format controls apply across ranges; drag-to-resize column widths persisted and round-tripped through XLSX cols.
edgeCases: function names like LOG10 not rewritten as refs
acceptance: shiftFormula matrix incl. anchors and #REF!
copy/paste rebases and recomputes at destination; openpyxl reads exported column widths
smoke: range bold + paste shows rebased formula

evidence.ref: clipboard.test.ts (5 suites) + cols round-trip; 135 unit total; smoke range scenario

knownLimitations: External paste is values-only TSV and needs clipboard-read permission; no fill handle, row heights, or multi-area selection

name: Fill handle
description: Drag the selection's corner grip to fill down or right: consistent-step numeric patterns continue as arithmetic series; other patterns cycle with formulas shifted per cell ($ anchors pinned); formats travel with their pattern cell.
acceptance: 1,2 filled down yields 3,4,5
=A1*10 filled down rebases to =A2*10, =A3*10
mixed patterns cycle
fill right works symmetrically
formats carried
edgeCases: single numeric value copies rather than extrapolating
results rounded to 10 decimal places to avoid float drift
knownLimitations: no geometric/date series; no fill up/left; no drag-to-shrink clearing
verification: unit + jsdom smoke; not independently reviewed

name: Row heights
description: Per-row custom heights (points, capped at 300): engine store mirroring column widths, drag the bottom edge of a row header to resize, persisted with the sheet, and round-tripped through XLSX as <row ht customHeight> including empty rows.
acceptance: drag resizes the row live and persists after reload
XLSX round-trip keeps heights, including rows with no cells
openpyxl reads exported heights exactly
edgeCases: heights rounded to 2 decimals, capped at 300pt, min 16px in the UI
rows without customHeight ignored on import
knownLimitations: no auto-fit to content; no multi-row resize in one drag
evidence: engines/spreadsheet-calc/test/engine.test.ts; engines/format-conversion/test/xlsx.test.ts row-height round-trip; openpyxl cross-validation; scripts/smoke-sheets.mjs row-height scenario
verification: unit + independent openpyxl parse + jsdom smoke; not independently reviewed

name: Multi-area selection
description: Ctrl/Cmd-click adds disjoint selection areas (Excel-style). Formatting (bold, number format, align) and Delete apply across every area with per-cell dedup; copy/cut of a multi-area selection is refused with a status message (no rectangular clip shape); the fill grip hides; the address label shows the area count. A plain click resets to one area.
acceptance: ctrl-click highlights both areas
bold/number/align hit every area once
Delete clears all areas
multi-area copy refused with message
plain click resets
edgeCases: the live anchor..focus rect is always the implicit last area
knownLimitations: no ctrl-drag to add a range area (click adds single cells / shift extends the live area)

name: Office-style ribbon
description: Tabbed ribbon (Home/Insert/Formulas/File) modeled on the Microsoft Office layout: familiar tab, group and command structure with quick-access undo/redo where the app supports it. Every implemented command is re-homed into its Office group fully wired; Office controls Casserole does not support yet are rendered in place but disabled with a 'not yet implemented' tooltip. Own glyph icons — no Microsoft artwork.
acceptance: tabs render and switch panels
existing controls keep working after the move (all prior smokes pass unchanged)
placeholders disabled with honest tooltips
at least one new ribbon-only action works (styles/clipboard/new slide)
edgeCases: controls are physically re-homed so listeners and ids survive
a missing control id is silently not shown rather than faked
knownLimitations: placeholder density is representative, not exhaustive — Office ships hundreds of commands
no contextual tabs (e.g. Table Design), no ribbon collapse, no keytips

name: Range sort
description: Sort A→Z / Z→A in the ribbon Editing group: sorts the selected range by its first column. Whole rows move together; formulas are rebased by their row delta ($ anchors pin); formats travel and vacated formats clear. Numbers before text ascending, text before numbers descending, empties always last (Excel semantics).
acceptance: mixed numbers/text/empty sort in Excel order both directions
companion columns move with their rows
formulas recalc correctly at new rows
formats travel; old locations cleared
edgeCases: single-cell selection refused with a status message
knownLimitations: sorts by the first column only (no sort-by-column picker, no multi-key)
verification: unit + jsdom smoke; not independently reviewed

name: Rich cell formats: borders, fill, font color, wrap, comma style, decimals
description: CellFormat gains border (box), fill, color, wrap, comma number style and a decimals override (0-10). Ribbon Font/Alignment/Number groups live. XLSX round-trips via a dynamic style table (deduped fonts/fills/borders/custom numFmts); import classifies them back including decimals from format codes.
acceptance: all five aspects + comma/decimals round-trip XLSX
openpyxl reads border=thin, fill/font ARGB, wrapText, #,##0.0 exactly
display honors decimals (1,234.6 / 42%)
edgeCases: builtin numFmt ids keep default decimals
knownLimitations: border is all-edges box only (no per-edge)
fill import reads solid patterns only
evidence: xlsx test suites; openpyxl cross-validation; smoke rich-formats scenario
verification: unit + independent openpyxl parse + jsdom smoke; not independently reviewed

name: Insert/delete rows and columns
description: shiftStructure inserts or deletes whole rows/columns at the selection (multi-row selections insert/delete that many): cells, formats and row heights/column widths move; formulas sheet-wide are rewritten through a generic ref mapper — references into a deleted zone become #REF!, later references shift, $ anchors shift too (they pin against copy, not against structure, as in Excel).
acceptance: insert shifts cells/formats/heights and rewrites SUM ranges
delete collapses refs to #REF! and recalcs survivors
column variant symmetric
edgeCases: cells on a deleted row/col are dropped entirely
knownLimitations: no undo for structural edits (sheet has no transaction log yet)
grid is fixed 12x40 — no growth on insert at the edge
evidence: clipboard test structural suites; smoke scenario
verification: unit + jsdom smoke; not independently reviewed

name: Find + function library
description: Ribbon Find prompts for text and jumps to the next matching cell (display or input, wrapping from the selection). Formulas tab Function Library menus (Math/Logical/Text/Count) start the chosen function in the formula bar.
acceptance: find wraps and selects the match
unknown function names refused
edgeCases: search covers both displayed text and raw input
knownLimitations: no replace; no match highlighting; prompt-based UI
